question: Which type of memory is mainly used to synchronise with a high-speed CPU and to improve its performance?
solution:
The correct answer is "**Cache Memory**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cache memory: **It is referred to as **quicker than most memory**. When compared to most memory, it takes less time to access it. It keeps the programs which will be run in a very short quantity of your time. It stores information for **temporary use**. It is mainly used to s**ynchronise** with a **high-speed CPU** and to improve its performance. But because of the semiconductors used, it's terribly overpriced. The size of the cache is typically tiny.

**Thus the correct answer is ***Cache Memory*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Primary memory: **Primary memory is formed from semiconductors and it is referred to as the main memory of the computing system. Data are stored in the primary memory temporarily. The size of the primary memory is smaller in comparison to the secondary memory. Primary memory is classified into 2 parts: RAM and ROM.
 
• **Secondary memory: **The secondary memory offers a larger storage system. After turning off the computer, the data, instructions and programs are not lost.
